arxiv-2203-05387.title: A New Guest in the Third Quantized Multiverse
arxiv-2203-05387.creator: Samuel Barroso Bellido, Fabian Wagner
arxiv-2203-05387.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Samuel Barroso Bellido, Fabian Wagner. In the present article we point out a conceptual issue of the Third Quantization formalism for Canonical Quantum Gravity. Based on earlier results on interuniversal entanglement, the picture of noninteracting universe-antiuniverse pairs is incomplete. In particular, the variation of the entanglement entropy with the scale factor, understood as a measure of time, implies either an interaction between pairs of universes or universes with a heat bath, i.

arxiv-2307-03177.title: PanoDiffusion: 360-degree Panorama Outpainting via Diffusion
arxiv-2307-03177.creator: Tianhao Wu, Chuanxia Zheng & Tat-Jen Cham
arxiv-2307-03177.description: Abstract Generating complete 360° panoramas from narrow field of view images is ongoing research as omnidirectional RGB data is not readily available. Existing GAN-based approaches face some barriers to achieving higher quality output, and have poor generalization performance over different mask types.

arxiv-2404-13569.title: Musical Word Embedding for Music Tagging and Retrieval
arxiv-2404-13569.creator: SeungHeon Doh, Jongpil Lee, Dasaem Jeong, Juhan Nam
arxiv-2404-13569.description: Abstract Word embedding has become an essential means for text-based information retrieval. Typically, word embeddings are learned from large quantities of general and unstructured text data. However, in the domain of music, the word embedding may have difficulty understanding musical contexts or recognizing music-related entities like artists and tracks.

arxiv-2503-23601.title: Exploring GPT-4 for Robotic Agent Strategy with Real-Time State Feedback and a Reactive Behaviour Framework
arxiv-2503-23601.creator: Thomas O’Brien, Ysobel Sims
arxiv-2503-23601.description: Abstract We explore the use of GPT-4 on a humanoid robot in simulation and the real world as proof of concept of a novel large language model (LLM) driven behaviour method. LLMs have shown the ability to perform various tasks, including robotic agent behaviour.

arxiv-2510-12591.title: Lower Bounds for Faithful Linear Representations of Subgroups of the Mapping Class Group
arxiv-2510-12591.creator: Thiago Brevidelli
arxiv-2510-12591.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Thiago Brevidelli. Recently, Korkmaz established the lower bound of 3 ​ g − 2 3g-2 for the dimension of a faithful representation of the mapping class group of an orientable surface of genus g ⩾ 3 g\geqslant 3 . We raise this bound to 4 ​ g − 3 4g-3 in the setting of surfaces of genus g ⩾ 7 g\geqslant 7 . A new ingredient is a finer study of the commutation relations in PMod ⁡ ( Σ ) \PMod(\Sigma) .

arxiv-2512-18568.title: Two-Component Dark Matter with an SU(2) Dark Sector
arxiv-2512-18568.creator: Shao-Long Chen, Wen-wen Jiang
arxiv-2512-18568.description: Abstract We propose an extension to the standard model incorporating a dark sector with a non-Abelian SU(2) gauge symmetry. The model yields stable dark matter candidates, protected by a residual Z 3 Z_{3} symmetry arising after the spontaneous symmetry breaking.

arxiv-2601-16239.title: Combining Tests and Proofs for Better Software Verification ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Software and its engineering Error handling and recovery CCS: Software and its engineering Software verification and validation CCS: Software and its engineering Software testing and debugging
arxiv-2601-16239.creator: Li Huang, Bertrand Meyer, Manuel Oriol
arxiv-2601-16239.description: Abstract . Test or prove? These two approaches to software verification have long been presented as opposites. One is dynamic, the other static: a test executes the program, a proof only analyzes the program text. A different perspective is emerging, in which testing and proving are complementary rather than competing techniques for producing software of verified quality.

pmc-10508944.title: Serum levels and gestational curve of adiponectin and leptin during adolescent pregnancy
pmc-10508944.creator: Indiomara Baratto, Silvia Daher, Mirela Douradinho Fernandes, Thalita Frutuoso Lobo, Karen Priscilla Tezotto Pendeloski, Edward Araujo, Cristina Aparecida Falbo Guazzelli
pmc-10508944.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SUMMARYOBJECTIVE:This study aimed to develop a curve of weekly serum levels of adiponectin and leptin among pregnant adolescents. In addition, pregestational body mass index and weight gain were assessed and correlated with the serum concentration of these molecules.METHODS:This was a prospective cohort study, including only pregnant adolescents with eutrophic pre-gestational body mass index who were weekly followed during the evolution of gestation.

pmc-10698126.title: Effect of cigarette smoking on the maintenance of reduction after treatment of acute acromioclavicular joint dislocation with hook plate fixation
pmc-10698126.creator: Jee-Hoon Choi, Yong-Min Chun, Tae-Hwan Yoon
pmc-10698126.description: BackgroundThe purpose of this study was to determine the association between smoking and clinical outcomes of hook plate fixation for acute acromioclavicular (AC) joint injuries.MethodsThis study retrospectively investigated 82 patients who underwent hook plate fixation for acute AC joint dislocation between March 2014 to June 2022.

pmc-11417869.title: Modified R-GLIM Score Is a Good Prognostic Tool to Predict a Long-Term Prognosis in Poor Conditioned Elderly Patients with Aspiration Pneumonia, a Pilot Study
pmc-11417869.creator: Yoshinori Wakita, Nobuhiro Asai, Wataru Ohashi, Naoharu Mori, Masato Maekawa, Hiroshige Mikamo, Hafiz TA Khan
pmc-11417869.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). While prognostic guidelines for pneumonia have widely allowed clinicians to treat patients, poor prognostic factors for 1- or 2-year survival times have never been mentioned to our knowledge. Patients and methods. We conducted this retrospective study to evaluate whether malnutrition according to the GLIM criteria is a poor prognostic factor for 1- or 2-year survival among patients with aspiration pneumonia.

pmc-11530559.title: Quantum-assisted federated intelligent diagnosis algorithm with variational training supported by 5G networks
pmc-11530559.creator: Arnaldo Rafael Camara Araujo, Ogobuchi Daniel Okey, Muhammad Saadi, Pablo Adasme, Renata Lopes Rosa, Demóstenes Zegarra Rodríguez
pmc-11530559.description: In the realm of intelligent healthcare, there is a growing ambition to reshape medical services through the integration of artificial intelligence (AI). However, conventional machine learning faces inherent challenges such as privacy issues, delayed updates, and protracted training times, particularly due to the hesitance of medical institutions to directly share sensitive data, with possible noises.

pmc-12503297.title: Cardiovascular risk prediction and influencing predictors identification among Bangladeshi individuals using machine learning algorithms and association rule mining
pmc-12503297.creator: Md. Merajul Islam, Sujit Kumar, Md. A. Salam, Dulal Chandra Roy, Md. Rezaul Karim
pmc-12503297.description: BackgroundCardiovascular disease (CVD) encompasses a group of disorders that affect the heart and blood vessels, making it one of the leading causes of death globally, including in Bangladesh. Applying predictive modeling for the early identification and detection of CVD holds significant promise for saving lives by enhancing prediction precision through machine learning algorithms.

pmc-12559250.title: Intratumoral plasma cells predict patient prognosis and responsiveness to neoadjuvant immunotherapy in advanced gastric cancer
pmc-12559250.creator: Jia-Bin Wang, Chen-Yang Jiang, Yin-Hua Ye, You-Xin Gao, Qiao-Ling Zheng, Hua-You Luo, Shuan-Hu Wang, Tao Zhang, Qin-Wen Jin, Chao-Hui Zheng, Ping Li, Jian-Xian Lin, Qi-Yue Chen, Long-Long Cao, Ying-Hong Yang, Chang-Ming Huang, Jian-Wei Xie
pmc-12559250.description: Limited biomarker availability hinders the accurate prognostication of individual responses to immunotherapy in gastric cancer (GC). Mature tertiary lymphoid structures (mTLS) substantially affect immunotherapeutic efficacy in patients. However, the inherent limitations of tissue size in gastroscopic biopsies necessitate the development of a new mTLS marker-based classification strategy.

pmc-12662169.title: Vitamin D Deficiency at Hospital Admission With Community-Acquired Pneumonia is Associated With Increased Risk of Mortality: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-12662169.creator: Maria Hein Hegelund, Sehrash Alam, Arnold Matovu Dungu, Camilla Koch Ryrsø, Daniel Faurholt-Jepsen, Rikke Krogh-Madsen, Tomas Oestergaard Jensen, Christian Mølgaard, Birgitte Lindegaard
pmc-12662169.description: BackgroundA deficient vitamin D status is linked to increased risk of community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) and both short- and long-term mortality. Given small sizes of previous studies and lack of adjustment for key confounders, we aimed to investigate the association between vitamin D status (sufficient, insufficiency, or deficiency) and mortality risk in adults hospitalized with CAP.

pmc-12717232.title: Exosomal proteomics reveals fatty acid metabolism linked to gefitinib resistance in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-12717232.creator: Yuanyuan Zhang, Wenjie Zhu, Jiang Zhu, Rui Hu, Yunhuang Yang
pmc-12717232.description: Exosomes play a crucial role in the transmission of drug resistance in tumors. However, the mechanism of exosomes-mediated transmission in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) under gefitinib treatment remains limited. In this work, we demonstrated that exosomes derived from HCC827/GR cells (drug-resistant) enhanced the survivability of HCC827 cells (drug-sensitive) under treatment with gefitinib.

pmc-12993182.title: Enhancing clinical insights in glioma grading using Bayesian Optimization and Explainable AI
pmc-12993182.creator: Alaa M Elsayad, Omar A Elsayad
pmc-12993182.description: Highlights•A novel framework for interpretable glioma grading is introduced, combining Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) with Bayesian Optimization and Explainable AI (XAI).•A Bayesian-optimized Generalized Additive Model (GAM) achieves superior or competitive performance compared to traditional machine learning models for glioma grade classification.

pmc-13134711.title: Vancomycin eliminates gut deoxycholic acid, restoring ER proteostasis in ILC2s and relieving colitis
pmc-13134711.creator: Qiuheng Tian, Han Liu, Xiang Gu, Jing Shen, Xi Yuan, Mengqi Zheng, Yunjiao Zhai, Yatai Chen, Penghu Han, Yangchun Ma, Wei Xin, Hongyue Ma, Yu Li, Sihan Wang, Lei Guo, Detian Yuan, Yanbo Yu, Shiyang Li
pmc-13134711.description: Ulcerative colitis (UC) remission is marked by gut microbiota restructuring, but how microbial metabolites influence immune-mediated tissue repair is unclear. Here, we demonstrate that oral vancomycin alleviates colitis symptoms in murine models, mirroring its clinical efficacy in inducing remission in patients with UC. Mechanistically, vancomycin’s therapeutic effect is achieved by reducing deoxycholic acid (DCA).

pmc-13216369.title: Clinical, radiographic, and histological evaluation of autogenous demineralized dentin matrix versus xenograft in alveolar ridge preservation: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13216369.creator: Yin Xu, Hui Zhang
pmc-13216369.description: PurposeThis randomized controlled trial aimed to evaluate the clinical and histological efficacy of autogenous demineralized dentin matrix (DDM) compared with deproteinized bovine bone mineral (DBBM) for alveolar ridge preservation (ARP), with a specific focus on dimensional stability and remodeling dynamics over a 6-month follow-up period.

pmc-13359356.title: Beyond participation: exploring leisure literacy and social adaptation within a physical literacy-informed perspective in adolescence
pmc-13359356.creator: Ali Selman Özdemir, Aydın Karaçam, Teodora-Mihaela Iconomescu, Laurențiu-Gabriel Talaghir
pmc-13359356.description: Physical literacy (PL) has emerged as a holistic framework supporting lifelong engagement in physical activity and well-being. Although PL research increasingly emphasizes social and contextual dimensions, less is known about how complementary competencies, such as leisure literacy, are associated with adolescents’ social adaptation.

pmc-13401604.title: Real-world effectiveness and impact of the 4CMenB vaccine against serogroup B invasive meningococcal disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13401604.creator: Pavo Marijic, Katarzyna Jamróz-Dolińska, Wojciech Margas, Lucian Gaianu, Gaurav Mathur, Piotr Wojciechowski, Thatiana Pinto, Tia Vincent, Helen Petousis-Harris, Terry Nolan, Federico Martinón-Torres, Lee H. Harrison, Zeki Kocaata
pmc-13401604.description: 4CMenB vaccine is authorized for protection against serogroup B invasive meningococcal disease (IMD). This study synthesized real-world evidence (RWE) data on effectiveness and impact of 4CMenB vaccine. A systematic search identified RWE on vaccine effectiveness (VE) and vaccine impact of 4CMenB in infants, children and adolescents. A meta-analysis was conducted of 4CMenB VE against serogroup B-IMD in infants and children.

pmc-13461325.creator: Alexandra Grigoreanu, Cristina Gaspar, Iulia Bucur, Alexandru Udrea, Razvan Cojocaru, Alex Moza, Alexandra Ban-Cucerzan, Cristian Lazarescu, Emil Tirziu, Ioan Tibru

pmc-13593749.title: Family cumulative risk and meaning in life among Chinese secondary vocational school students: the mediating role of self-esteem and the moderating role of labor education support perception
pmc-13593749.creator: Xuesong Du, Li Chen, Yanna Huang, Libo Jin, Lianjing Lu
pmc-13593749.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveThis cross-sectional survey study investigated the association between family cumulative risk and meaning in life among Chinese secondary vocational school students, examining the mediating role of self-esteem and the moderating role of labor education support perception.MethodsA questionnaire survey comprising the Family Cumulative Risk Scale, Meaning in Life Questionnaire (MLQ), Rosenberg’s Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), and Labor Education Support Perception Scale (LESPS) was administered to 1536 secondary vocational school students from various grades.ResultsFamily cumulative risk was significantly and negatively associated with meaning in life

pmc-13639674.title: Concurrent chemoradiotherapy for metastatic vulvar extramammary Paget’s disease involving supraclavicular nodes: a case report
pmc-13639674.creator: Soyoung Park, Jung-Woo Park, Sujin Kim
pmc-13639674.description: Extramammary Paget’s disease (EMPD) is a rare adenocarcinoma with a poor prognosis when invasive. Here, we report an exceptionally rare case of invasive vulvar EMPD in a 70-year-old woman who presented with extensive lymphadenopathy involving the inguinal, pelvic, para-aortic, and left supraclavicular regions. Histopathology confirmed dermal and lymphovascular invasion.

pmc-13665194.title: Changes in Visual Acuity and Dry Eye Parameters Following One Month of Scleral Lens Wear in Patients with Keratoconus: A Prospective Observational Study from Saudi Arabia
pmc-13665194.creator: Saleh R. Alshammeri
pmc-13665194.description: Background/Objectives: To evaluate the immediate visual correction provided by scleral lens insertion and short-term changes in ocular surface parameters associated with one month of scleral lens wear in patients with keratoconus in Saudi Arabia. Methods: This prospective observational study included 18 participants with keratoconus (18 study eyes).

pmc-13680270.title: Mapping genetic modifiers of epimutation rates identifies VIM2/4 as dosage-sensitive negative regulators of CG methylation maintenance
pmc-13680270.creator: Zhilin Zhang, Wilma Wanney, Yangyang Xu, Johan Zicola, Angela M Hancock, Robert J Schmitz, Frank Johannes
pmc-13680270.description: Spontaneous epimutations are stochastic gains and losses of cytosine methylation that arise from imperfect maintenance across cell divisions. At CG sites, such epimutations can be inherited across generations in plants and constitute a major source of CG methylation (mCG) diversity.
